nodes.label: Literal source filtering and bounded acquisition
nodes.rationale: Timezone-aware root dates use inclusive since and exclusive until. Literal exclude overrides include and may remove entire threads; comments need not match includes. Unknown root dates fail active date filters while estimated comments remain context. Minimums are targets, and time, access, CAPTCHA or HTTP 429 can yield partial results.

nodes.label: Compact Excel and verified reexport
nodes.rationale: social_data.xlsx uses one ten-column Data sheet with WIB root/content dates and explicit certainty. Relative estimates anchor to source observed_at. New bundles also retain full audit exports; user-supplied bundles can be compactly reexported after checksum/contract validation. TARGET_MET does not prove complete threads.

nodes.label: Reddit backend selection
nodes.rationale: HTML uses public pages, Playwright uses host Chrome/CLI, and checkpoint mode requires user-provided checkpoints. import_checkpoint_dir defaults to null. Access barriers stop acquisition, CAPTCHA is manual and cooldown is respected.

nodes.label: Five dashboard views
nodes.rationale: Overview, topic map, topic explanations, sentences/sources and methods/data combine quantitative comparison, semantic exploration and inspectable evidence.

nodes.label: Occurrence, sentence and comment units
nodes.rationale: Occurrences retain duplicates, unique sentences deduplicate, and platform/source_row identifies represented comments. Occurrence coverage 53.3% differs from unique coverage 53.1%. Explanation shares normalize topic-containing comments, not sentence counts; count charts may zero-fill while unsupported explanation shares have gaps.

nodes.label: Native URL state and bounded controls
nodes.rationale: Native query-parameter binding preserves platform/date/literal search/topic/view/slider state. Chart/table callbacks update topics before rerun, dropdowns offer keyboard alternatives and reset restores filters. Saved node_limit is clamped before slider construction as available topics shrink, including one/zero-topic cases.
nodes.norm_label: native url state and bounded controls

nodes.label: Accessible and safe dashboard rendering
nodes.rationale: Indonesian Babel formatting, tabular numerals, visible focus, contrast, wrapping, reduced motion and responsive layout support interpretation. Graph descriptions and tables provide alternatives; HTML quotations are escaped and source links restricted to HTTP(S).

nodes.label: Semantic similarity map interpretation
nodes.rationale: Topic codes, occurrence-sized nodes and continuous platform proportions retain stable full-model positions under filters. Isolated topics remain. Edges are semantic similarity, not account relationships, and layout axes are not calibrated semantic measurements.

nodes.label: Traceable topic explanations
nodes.rationale: Topic descriptions combine distinguishing vocabulary, original evidence with source references, temporal patterns, platform shares and limitations. Quotes are EXTRACTED; selection, interpretation and direction are INFERRED. Noise is not one coherent topic.

nodes.label: Extractive MMR descriptions
nodes.rationale: MMR balances weighted centroid/term/informativeness relevance with embedding redundancy; token Jaccard substitutes without embeddings. Source diversity is preferred and full evidence remains available behind excerpts. No abstractive diagnosis, sentiment or causal claim is generated.

nodes.label: Represented-comment topic share
nodes.rationale: Platform plus source_row identifies each comment, counted once per topic/month despite repeated sentences. The denominator includes all represented comments including noise, but excludes fully rejected rows. Multi-topic comments mean shares need not total 100%; source parents come from video/thread IDs with flagged context-hash fallback.

nodes.label: Calendar-aware descriptive direction
nodes.rationale: Default parent-post dates describe source-date distributions, not actual comment timing; optional content dates include estimates. Partial or unsupported months do not determine direction; no observations mean null, supported absence means zero. Theil–Sen slope, Kendall tau-b and pooled counts in two complete calendar windows jointly determine descriptive direction; tau is not a p-value or probability.

nodes.label: Support and platform-mixture sensitivity
nodes.rationale: Eligible-month, comment and independent-parent thresholds guard direction; insufficient support remains inspectable as unclear. Dominant parents and uncertain identity/dates limit support. Fixed-platform-weight comparisons annotate source-mixture shifts and opposing directions; they do not correct every crawl bias.

nodes.label: Within-topic phrase change
nodes.rationale: Supported per-comment frequencies for up to twelve full-model c-TF-IDF terms rank by smoothed log-odds. Rare/out-of-vocabulary terms are omitted and changes do not prove the birth of an issue.

nodes.label: Filtered explanation lifecycle
nodes.rationale: Subsets define evidence and denominators; added date bounds restrict temporal calculation without automatically cutting evidence. Full-model vocabulary/centroids/memberships stay fixed, and dashboard content-date analysis inherits its initial root-date filter. Lazy cache binds source manifest, filtered occurrences, range, options and algorithm hash. Optional source-bound sidecars use atomic non-overwriting publication without downloads, training or crawling.

nodes.label: Reddit Playwright runner
nodes.rationale: Uses separate host Chrome through Playwright CLI and extracts already-loaded rendered DOM, without RSS/API tokens. Manual CAPTCHA, HTTP 429/cooldown and access barriers stop capture. Host POSIX and isolated output profiles are required; the dashboard needs no browser runner.

nodes.label: User-supplied checkpoint integrity
nodes.rationale: Advanced campaigns require user-provided configuration/checkpoints. Checkpoint IDs, permalinks, subreddit and dates validate before atomic OS-locked persistence or reuse. Unloaded replies are not expanded, capture is not complete-thread proof and browser barriers do not prove deletion.

nodes.label: Connected-browser campaign helpers
nodes.rationale: Helpers parse dated search cards, capture public threads through supported connected tabs, extract rendered DOM and import uncertain web snippets. They are not standalone crawlers and do not copy personal credentials/profiles.

nodes.label: Checkpoint export and evidence limits
nodes.rationale: User-supplied checkpoint exports use the eight-sheet contract and verify dates, IDs, schema, counts and checksums. DOM-only excludes snippets; metadata preview explicitly has empty content. Candidate metadata and limited snippets are not proof of full thread acquisition; native IDs/provenance remain without sentiment/author-role inference.

nodes.rationale: Push and pull-request validation runs on Ubuntu with Python 3.12, read-only contents permission and nonpersistent checkout credentials, installing the root requirements.

Synthetic tests do not establish live access; remote workflow execution is not yet verified.

nodes.label: Eleven-file data allowlist

nodes.label: Saved-result dashboard runtime

nodes.label: Deployment and remote verification limits

nodes.label: Local multilingual topic-modeling pipeline
nodes.rationale: Fixed MiniLM embeddings feed UMAP, scikit-learn HDBSCAN and c-TF-IDF; local ONNX CPU encoding uses mask pooling, L2 normalization and overflow windows.

nodes.label: Heuristic model-selection tradeoff
nodes.rationale: KMeans K40 has the highest composite score, while HDBSCAN is chosen within tolerance for higher embedding separation. This is internal heuristic selection, not significance or semantic accuracy.

nodes.label: Sentence and occurrence provenance
nodes.rationale: Original text, spans, Excel source_row, context and WIB certainty remain traceable. Only embedding text is normalized; negation survives, contextual metadata is not a feature, and dedup retains all original occurrences.

nodes.label: Validated clustering storage contract
nodes.rationale: Nine analysis artifacts bind to manifest checksums without pickle. Loaders check schema, paths, hashes and embedding shape; sidecars have separate source identities.

nodes.label: Snapshot and semantic limitations

nodes.label: Metodologi Machine Learning Social NLP
nodes.source_location: # Metodologi Machine Learning Social NLP (graphify-out/obsidian/Metodologi Machine Learning Social NLP.md lines 1-14)
nodes.rationale: Audited implementation methodology separates source behavior, design choices and snapshot measurements.

nodes.label: Frozen encoder versus corpus fitting
nodes.source_location: ## 12. Apa yang dimaksud training (graphify-out/obsidian/Metodologi Machine Learning Social NLP.md lines 554-562)
nodes.rationale: Transformer weights remain fixed: no backward pass, optimizer or label training. UMAP, clustering and lexical representations fit the local corpus; explanation statistics do not fit forecasting, causal or sentiment models.

nodes.label: Explicit fit and explanation lifecycle
nodes.source_location: ## 2. Arsitektur dan alur fungsi (graphify-out/obsidian/Metodologi Machine Learning Social NLP.md lines 62-81)
nodes.rationale: fit_excel chains preparation, encoding, candidate comparison and topic description. save and explain_topics are separate operations; configuration overrides are validated and progress events expose stages.

nodes.label: Deduplicated fitting and occurrence units
nodes.source_location: ## 3. Dataset dan unit analisis (graphify-out/obsidian/Metodologi Machine Learning Social NLP.md lines 102-110)
nodes.rationale: Each unique embedding text has one fitting/c-TF-IDF vote; repeated source occurrences preserve original volume. Represented comments use platform/source_row. Dedup reduces repetition dominance without constituting validated spam/bot detection; metadata is context only.

nodes.label: Excel input and population guards
nodes.source_location: ### 4.1 Membaca dan memvalidasi sumber (graphify-out/obsidian/Metodologi Machine Learning Social NLP.md lines 118-120)
nodes.rationale: Read-only/data-only Excel input is hashed and must contain Data plus ten columns. Selected rows marked truncated fail preparation; empty or nonlinguistic segments retain explicit skip reasons.
nodes.limits_location: ### 4.3 Dua versi teks dan identitas (graphify-out/obsidian/Metodologi Machine Learning Social NLP.md lines 140)

nodes.label: Offset-preserving rule segmentation
nodes.source_location: ### 4.2 Segmentasi berbasis aturan (graphify-out/obsidian/Metodologi Machine Learning Social NLP.md lines 124-126)
nodes.rationale: Protected punctuation in URLs, emails, decimals and abbreviations preserves source offsets. Long segments split near word boundaries without discarding parts; slang and cross-sentence context remain limitations.

nodes.label: Embedding text and deterministic identities
nodes.source_location: ### 4.3 Dua versi teks dan identitas (graphify-out/obsidian/Metodologi Machine Learning Social NLP.md lines 138-149)
nodes.rationale: Embedding cleaning applies NFC, URL removal and whitespace only: no lowercase, stemming, translation or stopword removal. Dedup is case-sensitive and hash collisions with different text are rejected; original quotations and source URLs survive.

nodes.label: Pinned local multilingual ONNX encoder
nodes.source_location: ### 5.1 Encoder yang digunakan (graphify-out/obsidian/Metodologi Machine Learning Social NLP.md lines 157-159)
nodes.rationale: Quantized AVX2 MiniLM runs on CPUExecutionProvider with fixed pretrained weights. Public files download only when needed, token=False requests no account token, and weight/tokenizer identities are recorded.

nodes.label: Overflow windows and equal-window pooling
nodes.source_location: ### 5.2 Tokenisasi dan jendela panjang / ### 5.3 Pooling dan normalisasi (graphify-out/obsidian/Metodologi Machine Learning Social NLP.md lines 163-183)
nodes.rationale: All tokenizer overflow windows are encoded. Masked token means exclude padding; window vectors then receive equal weight before L2 normalization. Overlap and short final windows alter token influence, so this is not one mean over unique tokens.

nodes.label: Embedding cache identity and validation
nodes.source_location: ### 5.4 Cache (graphify-out/obsidian/Metodologi Machine Learning Social NLP.md lines 187-189)
nodes.rationale: Cache keys bind all model options, ordered embedding texts and code version, including batch/thread changes. Metadata plus NPY checksum and valid unit norms are required; allow_pickle=False applies. The dashboard needs saved embeddings, not the training cache.

nodes.label: UMAP and HDBSCAN candidate fitting
nodes.source_location: ### 6.1 HDBSCAN pada UMAP (graphify-out/obsidian/Metodologi Machine Learning Social NLP.md lines 197-212)
nodes.rationale: Six density-clustering combinations fit two cosine UMAP reductions; Euclidean scikit-learn HDBSCAN uses EOM. Seed 42 supplies the candidate and seed 43 stability, without ensembling. min_samples includes the point itself; membership_strength is not calibrated semantic/trend confidence.

nodes.label: Ordinary KMeans embedding baseline
nodes.source_location: ### 6.2 KMeans semantik (graphify-out/obsidian/Metodologi Machine Learning Social NLP.md lines 216-218)
nodes.rationale: KMeans fits original embeddings directly and assigns every point. It optimizes squared Euclidean distance, not spherical KMeans: centroids are not constrained to unit norm during fitting.

nodes.label: TF-IDF, SVD and KMeans baseline
nodes.source_location: ### 6.3 Baseline leksikal TF-IDF → SVD → KMeans (graphify-out/obsidian/Metodologi Machine Learning Social NLP.md lines 222-224)
nodes.rationale: Unigram/bigram TF-IDF and fixed-seed SVD feed normalized KMeans. Two KMeans seeds assess initialization stability while holding SVD fixed, so stability does not cover lexical-reduction uncertainty.

nodes.label: In-sample candidate evaluation
nodes.source_location: ## 6. Kandidat algoritma dan fitting (graphify-out/obsidian/Metodologi Machine Learning Social NLP.md lines 193,228-230)
nodes.rationale: All prepared unique sentences participate in fitting. There is no train/test split, cross-validation or early stopping. Ten candidates entail twenty clustering fits, two UMAP fits and one SVD; evaluation is internal rather than held-out semantic generalization.

nodes.label: Eligibility gates and original-space silhouette
nodes.source_location: ### 7.1 Coverage dan ukuran kelompok terbesar / ### 7.2 Silhouette cosine pada ruang yang sama (graphify-out/obsidian/Metodologi Machine Learning Social NLP.md lines 238-251)
nodes.rationale: Candidates need at least two clusters, computable silhouette, coverage >=0.40 and largest assigned-cluster share <=0.50. A fixed initial sample is scored in original 384D cosine space, including the lexical baseline. Assigned-only HDBSCAN and full KMeans sample subsets differ, leaving comparison bias.

nodes.label: Noise-aware two-seed ARI
nodes.source_location: ### 7.3 Stabilitas ARI dan penanganan noise (graphify-out/obsidian/Metodologi Machine Learning Social NLP.md lines 255-257)
nodes.rationale: ARI uses the union assigned in either seed, excludes jointly noisy points and converts remaining noise into distinct singleton labels. Fewer than eight union points gives zero. It measures seed agreement, not human correctness, population bootstrap or cross-platform/time robustness.

nodes.label: Composite score and tolerance policy
nodes.source_location: ### 7.4 Skor gabungan dan toleransi (graphify-out/obsidian/Metodologi Machine Learning Social NLP.md lines 263-276)
nodes.rationale: Failed gates receive no score; negative silhouette is retained but clipped in scoring. Eligible candidates near the highest score are selected lexicographically by silhouette, ARI and coverage, without hardcoding an algorithm name.

nodes.label: Sentence-level lexical vocabulary
nodes.source_location: ### 8.1 Membentuk vocabulary (graphify-out/obsidian/Metodologi Machine Learning Social NLP.md lines 305-307)
nodes.rationale: CountVectorizer learns on all unique embedding texts, including noise. min_df counts unique sentences, not clusters or occurrences. Lowercase and stopwords affect only lexical paths; lexical negation variants may disappear while embedding negation remains.

nodes.label: Sparse class TF-IDF weighting
nodes.source_location: ### 8.2 Agregasi kelas dan pembobotan (graphify-out/obsidian/Metodologi Machine Learning Social NLP.md lines 311-328)
nodes.rationale: Only assigned clusters form sparse lexical classes, avoiding cross-sentence bigrams. Vocabulary includes noise sentences but class counts/IDF use assigned sentences only. Weighting represents clusters without changing membership.

nodes.label: Automatic labels and centroid representatives
nodes.source_location: ### 8.3 Label dan contoh representatif (graphify-out/obsidian/Metodologi Machine Learning Social NLP.md lines 332-338)
nodes.rationale: Top lexical terms yield token-set-filtered labels; no semantic label generator is used. Tail terms may have zero weight and term weights are not persisted. Normalized original-embedding centroids select nearest unique sentences. Labels need human review and IDs are local to each refit.

nodes.label: Centroid graph and unused node cap
nodes.source_location: ## 9. Graf topik (graphify-out/obsidian/Metodologi Machine Learning Social NLP.md lines 342-348)
nodes.rationale: Per-topic nearest centroid neighbors above threshold form merged symmetric edges; final degree may exceed the per-source neighbor count. Every topic remains, including isolates. Edges are inferred cosine similarities, not probabilities or human relations; display layout is not clustering UMAP.
nodes.norm_label: centroid graph and unused node cap

nodes.label: Extractive relevance and MMR
nodes.source_location: ### 10.1 Deskripsi ekstraktif dan MMR (graphify-out/obsidian/Metodologi Machine Learning Social NLP.md lines 356-376)
nodes.rationale: Filtered evidence is sentence-deduplicated against full-model vocabulary/centroids. Ranked term matches, centrality and length guide MMR, with source diversity and token Jaccard fallback. Template excerpts preserve full source evidence; quotations are extracted and interpretation inferred.

nodes.label: Represented-comment trend denominator
nodes.source_location: ### 10.2 Populasi, tanggal dan denominator (graphify-out/obsidian/Metodologi Machine Learning Social NLP.md lines 380-390)
nodes.rationale: Each platform/source_row comment counts once per topic/month. All represented comments, including noise, enter denominators; rejected rows do not. Parent-date defaults differ from comment activity, estimated content dates retain caveats, unsupported months are null and observed topic absence may be zero.

nodes.label: Supported calendar direction and platform sensitivity
nodes.source_location: ### 10.3 Arah deskriptif dan dukungan / ### 10.4 Sensitivitas platform dan perubahan frasa (graphify-out/obsidian/Metodologi Machine Learning Social NLP.md lines 394-413)
nodes.rationale: Theil–Sen slope, tau-b and pooled complete-calendar-window shares guide descriptive labels without significance claims. Support, independent parents and platform-mixture checks constrain interpretation; parent dominance is a warning rather than automatic cancellation. Phrase change is supported per-comment frequency within full-model vocabulary.
nodes.norm_label: supported calendar direction and platform sensitivity

nodes.label: Forty-seven-field configuration contract
nodes.source_location: ## 11. Seluruh konfigurasi dan hyperparameter (graphify-out/obsidian/Metodologi Machine Learning Social NLP.md lines 425-538)
nodes.rationale: Locations/budgets, encoder, candidate search, evaluation/graph and explanations comprise 47 active fields. Code-fixed choices and environment-specific library defaults are separate; changing JSON does not retroactively change saved fits. No Transformer fine-tuning epoch/learning-rate fields exist.

nodes.label: Snapshot artifacts without prediction estimators
nodes.source_location: ### 13.1 Artifact yang disimpan (graphify-out/obsidian/Metodologi Machine Learning Social NLP.md lines 603-620)
nodes.rationale: Saved artifacts preserve analysis and integrity, not fitted UMAP/HDBSCAN/KMeans/vectorizers. No production predict/transform or incremental-cluster API exists; new data requires refitting and centroid cosine is not HDBSCAN prediction. Atomic saves reject overwrite and do not rewrite input.

nodes.label: Reproducibility and incomparable timing scopes
nodes.source_location: ### 13.2 Identitas dan keterulangan (graphify-out/obsidian/Metodologi Machine Learning Social NLP.md lines 624-630)
nodes.rationale: Hashes, pinned revisions, seeds and dependency versions reduce variation without guaranteeing identical CPU/library results. Snapshot fit time used cached embeddings; candidate times omit or include shared reduction work differently and are not fair end-to-end architecture benchmarks. Sampling speeds evaluation while fitting still uses the full prepared corpus.

nodes.label: Synthetic tests versus real-model validation
nodes.source_location: ## 14. Testing dan validasi (graphify-out/obsidian/Metodologi Machine Learning Social NLP.md lines 638-676)
nodes.rationale: Thirty-nine NLP/UI test methods verify behavior using a controlled synthetic six-dimensional encoder, not MiniLM semantic accuracy. High synthetic silhouette is not real-data accuracy. Character-window tests do not cover the complete production ONNX overflow path; AppTest needs real-browser URL checks. Human coherence, fairness, estimated-date accuracy and quantized-versus-float quality remain unproved.

nodes.label: Primary algorithm references
nodes.source_location: ### 16.2 Referensi primer (graphify-out/obsidian/Metodologi Machine Learning Social NLP.md lines 715-723)
nodes.rationale: Official model and library references ground encoder, reduction, clustering, silhouette, ARI and temporal-statistic definitions.

nodes.label: Proposed human and generalization validation
nodes.source_location: ## 15. Interpretasi dan pengembangan metodologi (graphify-out/obsidian/Metodologi Machine Learning Social NLP.md lines 684-694)
nodes.rationale: Stratified human annotation, multiple raters, more seeds and frozen comparison protocols are proposals, not implemented validation. Future labeled evaluation should split by parent thread to prevent leakage; methodological changes need a new run and preserved denominators/provenance/noise.

nodes.label: BERTopic c-TF-IDF reference
nodes.source_location: ### 16.2 Referensi primer (graphify-out/obsidian/Metodologi Machine Learning Social NLP.md lines 721)
nodes.rationale: Documents the class-based lexical representation concept; BeeSense is modular and not identical to BERTopic defaults.

nodes.label: Carbonell and Goldstein MMR (1998)
nodes.source_location: ### 16.2 Referensi primer (graphify-out/obsidian/Metodologi Machine Learning Social NLP.md lines 722)
nodes.rationale: Primary relevance-diversity reranking reference; project relevance weights and source priorities remain implementation choices.
